name: mobilewright-framework
description: Cross-platform (iOS + Android) MobileWright test framework for Sauce Labs My Demo App, with a Page Object Model and Allure reporting

scripts.allure:generate: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('allure-report', { recursive: true, force: true })" && allure generate && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');for (const name of fs.readdirSync('allure-report')) {if (name !== 'index.html') fs.rmSync(path.join('allure-report', name), { recursive: true, force: true });}"
